messages:
alex: Heads up 1 opened a docs PR adding a Private VPC -> KMS/HSM quickstart + SDK snippets for mTLS proxy chaining. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1310 :rocket:
jen: Thanks. Can you include a short migration checklist for hosted KMS -> on-prem HSM? Customers confused key-wrap metadata before.
alex: Added a 3-step migration checklist: export key-wrap metadata, import into HSM, rotate wrapping keys. Included one-line `rwd-key-export` example.
mina: Please note that some HSMs expose a unix socket while others listen on TCP (port 1500). Add a one-liner to check the listener.
alex: Added port matrix and `ss -ltnp | grep 1500` example plus note about unix-socket paths for PKCS#11.
jen: Also call out network edgecases: calico SNAT, kube-proxy iptables vs ipvs, conntrack timeouts. Small troubleshooting bullets would help.
alex: Added troubleshooting section with quick checks and a link to the internal onprem net-debug script.
kevin: For SDK snippet prefer `kms.internal` hostname. Include both python `requests` and curl examples. And explicitly forbid `verify=False` in examples.
alex: Switched to kms.internal and added both snippets. Python:
```python
import requests
resp = requests.post("https://kms.internal/v1/sign", cert=("/etc/ssl/client.crt","/etc/ssl/client.key"), json={"payload":"..."}, verify="/etc/ssl/ca.pem")
print(resp.status_code)
```
Curl:
```bash
curl --cert client.pem --key client.key --cacert ca.pem https://kms.internal/v1/sign -d '{"payload":"..."}'
```
Also added a dev-only `-k` example flagged as unsafe.

mina: tiny nit: move SDK snippets into `/snippets/kms` so theyre easy to copy.
alex: Moved snippets to that folder and fixed internal links. Requested reviews from @jen and @mina.
jen: LGTM aside from one wording nit on PKCS11 path.
mina: Approve.
